blocks.text: 1 Samuel 29 contains 11 verses. It opens with: Now the Philistines gathered together all their hosts to Aphek: and the Israelites encamped by the fountain which is in Jezreel. It concludes with: So David rose up early, he and his men, to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: First Samuel moves from Eli's failing priestly house through Samuel's prophetic leadership and Saul's rejected kingship to David's anointing, rise, exile, and Saul's death.
